name: Joel Crawford
source:
Likes: My first love
Dislikes: Her tears
Hobby: Collecting magical plants
Skill: Spellsinging

"I've been waiting for you."

Elias: Joel Crawford is a gifted spellsinger, who is able to cast a magic by singing. He doesn't need to use a wand when casting spells.
I've seen his performance once, and it was terrific.
With his cool personality and high grades, he is very popular amongst the female students.
I've seen him being asked out for a couple of times but...
It looks like he already has someone decided in his heart.
He is such a serious man...and I like it.

[Official in-game description]
